## Objective
- Build a complete, playable Go-inspired tactics game with Hearthstone/auto-chess-style units, health, and abilities.

## Requirements
- Implement without clarification, make reasonable assumptions, and briefly note them at completion.
- Save small JPEG check screenshots (viewport ≤1280px) and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- Korean-language, single-file browser game: 9×9 board, unit cards and abilities, AI opponent, core-destruction win condition.
- Turn-based rules: place units, move or attack with each unit once per turn, and gain 3 energy each turn.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented the game in `index.html`, including responsive UI, combat, AI turns, rules and intro modals, restart, and win/loss states.
- Adjusted the board grid styling and inspected the latest screenshot at `/tmp/opencode/stone-arena.jpg`.
- Verified JavaScript syntax with `node --check /tmp/opencode/game.js`.
- Browser-tested unit placement, energy-based pulse damage, unit movement, and end-turn AI behavior.

### Active
- Verify win/loss handling; it is implemented but has not been browser-tested.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Test win and loss states in the browser.
2. Report controls and assumptions briefly to the user.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed project files as untracked.
